process.label: OUR PROCESS
process.title: How We Deliver Your Vision, Step by Step

steps.title: Connect with Us
steps.description: Share your basic details through a quick call. Our team consults with you through a free consultation.

steps.title: Define Your Requirement
steps.description: Discuss your plot details, budget, and timeline with our experts. We craft a clear project plan tailored to your goals.

steps.title: Approve Design
steps.description: Review floor plans, drawings, material selection, and scheduling. Work closely with our architects until every detail is finalized.

steps.title: Build & Monitor
steps.description: Our team ensures high quality standards through structured inspections at every project milestone. Stay updated on construction progress with daily photos, quality reports, and payment updates shared via WhatsApp.

steps.title: Handover & Support
steps.description: Take possession of your fully completed home with confidence, backed by a 10-year warranty. We ensure a smooth transition through final walkthroughs, complete documentation, and dedicated post-completion support.
